stages.native:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM public.warehouse_run_report_status [[WHERE dag_run_id = {{run_id}}]]
 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, dag_run_id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT x.kind AS "구분", x.code AS "코드" FROM (SELECT 1) seed LEFT JOIN selected s ON true
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT 0 AS ord, '알림 대상' AS kind, unnest(CASE WHEN s.dag_run_id IS NULL THEN ARRAY['기록 없음'] ELSE string_to_array(COALESCE(s.alert_codes,'판정 없음'), ', ') END) AS code
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 1, '전체 판정', unnest(CASE WHEN s.dag_run_id IS NULL THEN ARRAY['기록 없음'] ELSE string_to_array(COALESCE(s.failure_codes,'판정 없음'), ', ') END)
) x ORDER BY x.ord

description: 기록된 전체 판정과 domain_publish_alert 대상 코드다. 외부 알림을 발송했다는 뜻은 아니다.
